caveats: ATTRIBUTION IS NOT ISOLATED. The improvement lies inside 288c64f1 -> 7da92182, but two changes in that window can move NV detection: the Pass-1 layout-stratified sampler (99b853cc; NV is over the token budget and samples, and the new sample spans pages 1-15 vs 1-12 with 32 buckets vs 29) and rule 4's 'code is REQUIRED, never null' prompt clarification (b35b9666). The parser repairs cannot affect this arm, and the widened _DERIVABLE_CODE_RE cannot either since TECH is 4 chars and already matched the old {1,5} bound. An A/B is needed to separate them.

The batched run outputs/08-22-26-4 produced S/SS/T on 2026-08-22 while the direct-path recording the same day (288c64f1) still emitted Science/TECH. That is the direct-vs-batched divergence, not evidence that the fix predates this week.

NV's SS domain code still passes BY COINCIDENCE — derive_code_from_title('Social Studies') happens to return SS (see task2_20260816/findings.md section 4). A change to derive_code_from_title or the connector list turns 46/46 into 45/46 with nothing else moving.

GUARDRAIL 8 STILL APPLIES TO NV. Raw precision 0.8846 is not a hallucination rate; 5 of the 6 in-scope non-golden detections are correct re-detections of headings the document reprints on a second page spread. NV keeps the verified-precision path. KY remains the one detection-exhaustive golden (44 golden vs 44 in-scope), so its raw precision 1.0000 is a real hallucination rate.

The description 2/3 -> 3/3 move is on the DIRECT path, where CLAUDE.md records _splice_overlapping_prose as inert. The splice is therefore NOT the cause; the changed Pass-1 sample is the likeliest one. One run, not isolated.

The ICOPPPTM over-long-code defect that motivated 7da92182 does not appear in this arm — KY's direct-path run coded ICOPP correctly at both hashes. It was a batched-path observation (pipeline run 043).
not_wired_into_tables: generate_tables.py reads task1_<RUN_TAG>/summary.json AND task2_<RUN_TAG>/summary.json for one shared RUN_TAG, currently 20260822. Moving the tag to 20260826 requires three things that do not exist yet: (1) task1_20260826/ — the golden four have not been re-recorded at this hash, so moving the tag now breaks table generation; (2) a summary.json here, which consolidate_task1.py --state NV --state KY produces and which needs a parser report to consolidate against; (3) a re-signed nv_fp_audit_SIGNED.json, since the existing signature covers 53 detections and this run produced 52.
